method: Single 1024x1024 txt2img generation: LoraLoader(soviet_brutalism_style_v1) -> LoraLoader(identity, chained) -> IPAdapterUnifiedLoader + IPAdapterAdvanced (concept sheet) -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage. No ControlNet. The prompt itself requests front/side/back whole-figure views plus separated limb reference parts on a flat background; layout is not script-composited at this tier. Promotion appends a script-composited row below the generation (compose_master_sheet_with_parts, ['head', 'lower_arm_hand', 'lower_leg_boot', 'torso_coat', 'upper_arm']), cropping genuinely-isolated regions straight out of this same coherent image rather than relying on the model to render isolated limbs (DL-30 sanctions script arrangement of diffusion-sampled pixels).
